scope: Exactly three existing private observations: two cold getters repaired to include actual fast-lane and compact-transfer state, and the unchanged synchronized traversal-frontier tuple explicitly distinguished from the fast cached segment index. Numeric observations grant no lease, native-pointer or publication authority.
unreviewedScope: Other concurrent owner/kernel properties, demo roles and the remaining full API/lifecycle/performance/platform/release inventory remain separately required. This three-property registry cannot declare that inventory complete or constitute package-user access.
consistency: Cold getter takes the existing kernel gate and reads actual current-generation fields, published fast state and volatile transfer slot tags. Fast-lane writes do not take that gate: individual values are observations, not a multi-field atomic snapshot. Use a stable entered callback, explicit inter-thread handshake or quiescent maintenance boundary for exact assertions.
resetPolicy: Publication/abort remove initialization state; borrow exit removes operation depth. Generation transitions exclude old-generation hazards/slots. No current generation yields actual zero counts and the existing traversal tuple (0,-1,0). Numeric captures never resurrect returned handles.

fields.name: CurrentInitializationCountForTest
fields.definition: Checked sum of current synchronized generation initializations, actual Initializing compact-transfer slots and the active owner-thread fast initializer associated with this current generation. Prepared transfer publication remains initializing until publish/abort. Empty payload initializers still count; no operation token is invented for a reservation that has no entered borrow.
fields.overflow: All observation additions are checked; overflow cannot fabricate a smaller count.
fields.allocation: None. Walk existing published slot banks only during this cold capture; no new hot field/write or per-reservation metadata.

fields.name: CurrentGenerationActiveOperationsForTest
fields.units: entered current-generation admission and borrow operations
fields.definition: Checked sum of existing synchronized generation operation admission, compact-transfer slot operation tags and owner-thread nested fast-local borrow depth when its published hazard belongs to the current generation. General slow initializer admissions are included because they really own a token. Fast/compact initialization reservations alone are reported by initializer count, not invented as borrowed operation tokens. Retired-generation activity is excluded from this current-generation probe.
fields.overflow: Checked existing counts and observation sum; never wraps into zero.
fields.allocation: None. Reads existing admitted-operation/hazard/depth state and walks existing compact-transfer banks only during cold capture. No extra hot increment/atomic/synchronization.

fields.name: CurrentBumpTraversalForTest
fields.units: ordinary synchronized search frontier, scoped synchronized search frontier, actual current bump-bank segment count
fields.definition: Actual generation.OrdinaryBumpTraversalIndex and generation.ScopedBumpTraversalIndex, NOT the independently cached fast-lane segment positions reported by public diagnostics. An ordinary frontier of zero while the fast cache points at a later segment is a real measurement, not missing telemetry. A synchronized rooted scratch advances this frontier; generation reuse resets ordinary to zero and scoped to the final bank position. SegmentCount is the actual bank count. Preserve the absent-current tuple (0,-1,0).
fields.overflow: Actual bounded list frontiers/count, no historical saturating counter.
fields.allocation: None. Existing direct fields under the cold getter's kernel gate; no source or allocation-path change.
